percent_by_class.specified_offences: up to 50% relief on the pending fine

note: Bihar's one-time settlement took effect at the 9 May 2026 National Lok Adalat under Patna High Court supervision and remains operational through financial year 2026-27. It gives up to 50% relief on e-challans pending more than 90 days for specified offences; serious violations such as using a handheld mobile while driving are excluded and attract the full penalty. Settlement happens at National Lok Adalat sittings — the next is on 12 September 2026.
